using Logging
using TempDirs

mutable struct Hmmsearch
    binary_path::String
    hmmbuild_runner::Any
    database_path::String
    flags::Tuple
    
    function Hmmsearch(;
        binary_path::String,
        hmmbuild_binary_path::String,
        database_path::String,
        alphabet::String = "amino",
        filter_f1::Union{Float64, Nothing} = nothing,
        filter_f2::Union{Float64, Nothing} = nothing,
        filter_f3::Union{Float64, Nothing} = nothing,
        e_value::Union{Float64, Nothing} = nothing,
        inc_e::Union{Float64, Nothing} = nothing,
        dom_e::Union{Float64, Nothing} = nothing,
        incdom_e::Union{Float64, Nothing} = nothing,
        filter_max::Bool = false,
    )
        hmmbuild_runner = Hmmbuild(alphabet=alphabet, binary_path=hmmbuild_binary_path)
        flags = Any[]
        if filter_max
            push!(flags, "--max")
        else
            if filter_f1 !== nothing
                append!(flags, ["--F1", filter_f1])
            end
            if filter_f2 !== nothing
                append!(flags, ["--F2", filter_f2])
            end
            if filter_f3 !== nothing
                append!(flags, ["--F3", filter_f3])
            end
        end
        if e_value !== nothing
            append!(flags, ["-E", e_value])
        end
        if inc_e !== nothing
            append!(flags, ["--incE", inc_e])
        end
        if dom_e !== nothing
            append!(flags, ["--domE", dom_e])
        end
        if incdom_e !== nothing
            append!(flags, ["--incdomE", incdom_e])
        end
        flags_tuple = tuple(string.(flags)...)
        check_binary_exists(path=binary_path, name="hmmsearch")
        if !isfile(database_path)
            @error "Could not find hmmsearch database $database_path"
            error("Could not find hmmsearch database $database_path")
        end
        new(binary_path, hmmbuild_runner, database_path, flags_tuple)
    end
end

function query_with_hmm(self::Hmmsearch, hmm::String)::String
    mktempdir() do query_tmp_dir
        hmm_input_path = joinpath(query_tmp_dir, "query.hmm")
        sto_out_path = joinpath(query_tmp_dir, "output.sto")
        open(hmm_input_path, "w") do f
            write(f, hmm)
        end
        cmd = [
            self.binary_path,
            "--noali",
            "--cpu", "8",
        ]
        if !isempty(self.flags)
            append!(cmd, collect(self.flags))
        end
        append!(cmd, [
            "-A", sto_out_path,
            hmm_input_path,
            self.database_path,
        ])
        run_subprocess(
            cmd=cmd,
            cmd_name="Hmmsearch ($(basename(self.database_path)))",
            log_stdout=false,
            log_stderr=true,
            log_on_process_error=true,
        )
        a3m_out = open(sto_out_path) do f
            convert_stockholm_to_a3m(f, remove_first_row_gaps=false, linewidth=60)
        end
        return a3m_out
    end
end

function query_with_a3m(self::Hmmsearch, a3m_in::String)::String
    hmm = build_profile_from_a3m(self.hmmbuild_runner, a3m_in)
    return query_with_hmm(self, hmm)
end

function query_with_sto(self::Hmmsearch, msa_sto::String, model_construction::String = "fast")::String
    hmm = build_profile_from_sto(self.hmmbuild_runner, msa_sto, model_construction=model_construction)
    return query_with_hmm(self, hmm)
end

using Functors
using JAX

abstract type GatedLinearUnit end

function (glu::GatedLinearUnit)(
    x::Array,
    weight::Array;
    activation::Union{Function, Nothing} = nothing,
    precision::Union{Symbol, Nothing} = nothing,
    kwargs...
)
    return _fwd(glu, x, weight, activation=activation, precision=precision, kwargs...)
end

function vmap_rule_forward(glu::GatedLinearUnit)
    function _vmap_rule(axis_size, in_batched, args...; fn)
        sequential_vmap = sequential_vmap_fn(fn.fun)
        return vmap_rule(sequential_vmap, axis_size, in_batched, args...)
    end
    return _vmap_rule
end

function apply_vmap_rule_forward(glu::GatedLinearUnit, fn::Function; kwargs...)
    fn_closed(args...) = fn(args...; kwargs...)
    fn_closed_vmap = custom_vmap(fn_closed)
    vmap_rule_func(args...; kw...) = vmap_rule_forward(glu)(args...; kw..., fn=fn_closed_vmap)
    def_vmap(fn_closed_vmap, vmap_rule_func)
    return fn_closed_vmap
end

function gated_linear_unit_xla(
    x::Array,
    weight::Array;
    activation::Union{Function, Nothing} = nothing,
    precision::Union{Symbol, Nothing} = nothing,
)
    weight_reshaped = collapse(weight, start_dimension=-2, stop_dimension=nothing)
    @assert ndims(weight_reshaped) == 2
    y = dot(x, weight_reshaped, precision=precision)
    y = convert(promote_type(eltype(x), Float32), y)
    a, b = split(y, 2, dims=size(y, ndims(y)))
    out = activation === nothing ? a .* b : activation.(a) .* b
    out = convert(eltype(x), out)
    return out
end

using Functors
using JAX

const Pytree = Any
const PytreeJaxArray = Any
const partial = Base.Fix1
const PROXY = gensym(:proxy)

function _maybe_slice(array, i, slice_size, axis)
    if axis === PROXY
        return array
    else
        return dynamic_slice_in_dim(array, i, slice_size=slice_size, axis=axis)
    end
end

function _maybe_get_size(array, axis)
    if axis == PROXY
        return -1
    else
        return size(array, axis)
    end
end

function _expand_axes(axes, values, name="sharded_apply")
    values_tree_def = tree_structure(values)
    flat_axes = flatten_axes(name, values_tree_def, axes)
    flat_axes = [x === nothing ? PROXY : x for x in flat_axes]
    return tree_unflatten(values_tree_def, flat_axes)
end

function sharded_map(
    fun::Function;
    shard_size::Union{Int, Nothing} = 1,
    in_axes::Union{Int, Pytree} = 0,
    out_axes::Union{Int, Pytree} = 0,
)
    if running_init()
        return vmap(fun, in_axes=in_axes, out_axes=out_axes, split_rng=false)
    else
        vmapped_fun = vmap(fun, in_axes, out_axes, split_rng=true)
        return sharded_apply(vmapped_fun, shard_size, in_axes, out_axes)
    end
end

function _set_docstring(docstr::String)
    function wrapped(fun)
        fun_name = string(fun)
        return fun
    end
    return wrapped
end

function sharded_apply(
    fun::Function,
    shard_size::Union{Int, Nothing} = 1;
    in_axes::Union{Int, Pytree} = 0,
    out_axes::Union{Int, Pytree} = 0,
    new_out_axes::Bool = false,
)
    docstr = "Mapped version of fun. Takes similar arguments to fun but with additional array axes over which fun is mapped."
    if new_out_axes
        error("New output axes not yet implemented.")
    end
    if shard_size === nothing
        return fun
    end
    
    function mapped_fn(args...; kwargs...)
        in_axes_ = _expand_axes(in_axes, args)
        in_sizes = tree_map(_maybe_get_size, args, in_axes_)
        in_size = maximum(tree_leaves(in_sizes))
        num_extra_shards = div(in_size - 1, shard_size)
        last_shard_size = in_size % shard_size
        last_shard_size = last_shard_size == 0 ? shard_size : last_shard_size
        
        function apply_fun_to_slice(slice_start, slice_size)
            input_slice = tree_map(
                (array, axis) -> _maybe_slice(array, slice_start, slice_size, axis),
                args,
                in_axes_,
            )
            return fun(input_slice...; kwargs...)
        end
        
        remainder_shape_dtype = eval_shape(
            () -> apply_fun_to_slice(0, last_shard_size)
        )
        out_dtypes = tree_map(x -> eltype(x), remainder_shape_dtype)
        out_shapes = tree_map(x -> size(x), remainder_shape_dtype)
        out_axes_ = _expand_axes(out_axes, remainder_shape_dtype)
        
        if num_extra_shards > 0
            regular_shard_shape_dtype = eval_shape(
                () -> apply_fun_to_slice(0, shard_size)
            )
            shard_shapes = tree_map(x -> size(x), regular_shard_shape_dtype)
            
            function make_output_shape(axis, shard_shape, remainder_shape)
                return (
                    shard_shape[1:axis-1]...,
                    shard_shape[axis] * num_extra_shards + remainder_shape[axis],
                    shard_shape[axis+1:end]...
                )
            end
            out_shapes = tree_map(make_output_shape, out_axes_, shard_shapes, out_shapes)
        end
        
        function dynamic_update_slice_in_dim(full_array, update, axis, i)
            return dynamic_update_slice_in_dim_lax(full_array, update, i, axis)
        end
        
        function compute_shard(outputs, slice_start, slice_size)
            slice_out = apply_fun_to_slice(slice_start, slice_size)
            update_slice = (fa, upd, ax) -> dynamic_update_slice_in_dim(fa, upd, ax, slice_start)
            return tree_map(update_slice, outputs, slice_out, out_axes_)
        end
        
        function scan_iteration(outputs, i)
            new_outputs = compute_shard(outputs, i, shard_size)
            return new_outputs, ()
        end
        
        slice_starts = 0:shard_size:(in_size - shard_size)
        
        function allocate_buffer(dtype, shape)
            return zeros(dtype, shape)
        end
        
        outputs = tree_map(allocate_buffer, out_dtypes, out_shapes)
        if length(slice_starts) > 0
            outputs, _ = scan(scan_iteration, outputs, collect(slice_starts))
        end
        if last_shard_size != shard_size
            remainder_start = in_size - last_shard_size
            outputs = compute_shard(outputs, remainder_start, last_shard_size)
        end
        return outputs
    end
    return mapped_fn
end

function inference_subbatch(
    module::Function,
    subbatch_size::Int,
    batched_args::Vector,
    nonbatched_args::Vector;
    input_subbatch_dim::Int = 0,
    output_subbatch_dim::Union{Int, Nothing} = nothing,
)
    @assert length(batched_args) > 0
    if running_init()
        args = vcat(batched_args, nonbatched_args)
        return module(args...)
    end
    if output_subbatch_dim === nothing
        output_subbatch_dim = input_subbatch_dim
    end
    
    function run_module(batched_args...)
        args = vcat(collect(batched_args), nonbatched_args)
        res = module(args...)
        return res
    end
    
    sharded_module = sharded_apply(
        run_module,
        shard_size=subbatch_size,
        in_axes=input_subbatch_dim,
        out_axes=output_subbatch_dim,
    )
    output = sharded_module(batched_args...)
    return output
end

using TempDirs

function _to_a3m(sequences::Vector{String}, name_prefix::String = "sequence")::String
    a3m = ""
    for (i, sequence) in enumerate(sequences)
        a3m *= "> $name_prefix $i\n$sequence\n"
    end
    return a3m
end

mutable struct Hmmalign
    binary_path::String
    
    function Hmmalign(binary_path::String)
        check_binary_exists(path=binary_path, name="hmmalign")
        new(binary_path)
    end
end

function align_sequences(
    self::Hmmalign,
    sequences::Vector{String},
    profile::String,
    extra_flags::Union{Dict{String, String}, Nothing} = nothing,
)::String
    return align(
        self,
        a3m_str=_to_a3m(sequences, name_prefix="query"),
        profile=profile,
        extra_flags=extra_flags,
    )
end

function align(
    self::Hmmalign,
    a3m_str::String,
    profile::String,
    extra_flags::Union{Dict{String, String}, Nothing} = nothing,
)::String
    mktempdir() do query_tmp_dir
        input_profile = joinpath(query_tmp_dir, "profile.hmm")
        input_sequences = joinpath(query_tmp_dir, "sequences.a3m")
        output_a3m_path = joinpath(query_tmp_dir, "output.a3m")
        
        open(input_profile, "w") do f
            write(f, profile)
        end
        open(input_sequences, "w") do f
            write(f, a3m_str)
        end
        
        cmd = [
            self.binary_path,
            "-o", output_a3m_path,
            "--outformat", "A2M",
        ]
        
        if extra_flags !== nothing
            for (flag_name, flag_value) in extra_flags
                append!(cmd, [flag_name, flag_value])
            end
        end
        append!(cmd, [input_profile, input_sequences])
        
        run_subprocess(
            cmd=cmd,
            cmd_name="hmmalign",
            log_stdout=false,
            log_stderr=true,
            log_on_process_error=true,
        )
        
        a3m = open(output_a3m_path, encoding="utf-8") do f
            read(f, String)
        end
        return a3m
    end
end

function align_sequences_to_profile(self::Hmmalign, profile::String, sequences_a3m::String)::String
    deletion_table = Dict('-' => "")
    sequences_no_gaps_a3m = String[]
    for (seq, desc) in lazy_parse_fasta_string(sequences_a3m)
        push!(sequences_no_gaps_a3m, ">$desc")
        cleaned_seq = replace(seq, '-' => "")
        push!(sequences_no_gaps_a3m, cleaned_seq)
    end
    sequences_no_gaps_a3m = join(sequences_no_gaps_a3m, "\n")
    aligned_sequences = align(self, sequences_no_gaps_a3m, profile)
    return aligned_sequences
end

using LinearAlgebra
using Random

const BOND_THRESHOLD_GLYCANS_ANGSTROM = 1.7

function get_inter_chain_bonds(
    struct,
    allowed_chain_types1::Vector{String},
    allowed_chain_types2::Vector{String},
    allowed_res_names::Union{Vector{String}, Nothing} = nothing,
    include_bond_types::Set{String} = Set(["covale"]),
    bond_threshold::Float64 = BOND_THRESHOLD_GLYCANS_ANGSTROM,
    allow_multiple_bonds_per_atom::Bool = false,
)
    from_atoms = get_bond_atoms(struct.bonds, struct, 0)
    dest_atoms = get_bond_atoms(struct.bonds, struct, 1)
    
    chain_mask = (
        (in.(from_atoms.chain_type, Ref(allowed_chain_types1)) .& in.(dest_atoms.chain_type, Ref(allowed_chain_types2)))
        .| (in.(from_atoms.chain_type, Ref(allowed_chain_types2)) .& in.(dest_atoms.chain_type, Ref(allowed_chain_types1)))
    )
    
    if allowed_res_names !== nothing
        res_mask = in.(from_atoms.res_name, Ref(allowed_res_names)) .| in.(dest_atoms.res_name, Ref(allowed_res_names))
        all_mask = chain_mask .& res_mask
    else
        all_mask = chain_mask
    end
    
    type_mask = in.(struct.bonds.type, Ref(collect(include_bond_types)))
    all_mask .&= type_mask
    
    bond_length_squared = sum((from_atoms.coords .- dest_atoms.coords).^2, dims=2)
    bond_threshold_squared = bond_threshold * bond_threshold
    all_mask .&= bond_length_squared .< bond_threshold_squared
    
    ligand_types = ["LIGAND_TYPES"]
    is_ligand = in.(from_atoms.chain_type, Ref(ligand_types)) .| in.(dest_atoms.chain_type, Ref(ligand_types))
    
    res_id_differs = from_atoms.res_id .!= dest_atoms.res_id
    chain_id_differs = from_atoms.chain_id .!= dest_atoms.chain_id
    is_inter_res = res_id_differs .| chain_id_differs
    is_inter_ligand_res = is_inter_res .& is_ligand
    is_inter_chain_not_ligand = chain_id_differs .& .!is_ligand
    
    combined_allowed_bonds = is_inter_chain_not_ligand .| is_inter_ligand_res
    all_mask .&= combined_allowed_bonds
    
    bond_layout = AtomLayout(
        atom_name=hcat(from_atoms.atom_name[all_mask], dest_atoms.atom_name[all_mask]),
        res_id=hcat(from_atoms.res_id[all_mask], dest_atoms.res_id[all_mask]),
        chain_id=hcat(from_atoms.chain_id[all_mask], dest_atoms.chain_id[all_mask]),
    )
    
    if !allow_multiple_bonds_per_atom
        bond_layout = _remove_multi_bonds(bond_layout)
    end
    
    return fill_in_optional_fields(
        bond_layout,
        reference_atoms=atom_layout_from_structure(struct),
    )
end

using JAX

const Implementation = Union{Symbol}

mutable struct PallasGatedLinearUnit <: GatedLinearUnit
end

function _fwd(glu::PallasGatedLinearUnit, x, weight; activation, precision)
    weight_view = ArrayView(weight)
    return apply_vmap_rule_forward(
        glu,
        gated_linear_unit_matmul,
        activation=activation,
        precision=precision,
    )(
        x,
        weight_view[:, 2],
        weight_view[:, 1],
    )
end

function gated_linear_unit(
    x::Array,
    weight::Array;
    activation::Union{Function, Nothing} = nothing,
    precision::Union{Symbol, Nothing} = nothing,
    implementation::Union{Symbol, Nothing} = nothing,
)
    if implementation == :triton
        if !has_triton_support()
            error("Triton not supported on this platform.")
        end
    end
    
    if string(eltype(x)) != string(eltype(weight))
        error("Input and weight must have the same dtype. $(eltype(x)) != $(eltype(weight))")
    end
    
    if implementation !== nothing
        named_args = [:xla, :triton]
        if !(implementation in named_args)
            error("Unsupported named implementation. Must be one of $named_args.")
        end
    end
    
    if implementation === nothing || implementation == :triton
        try
            return PallasGatedLinearUnit()(
                x=x,
                weight=weight,
                activation=activation,
                precision=precision,
            )
        catch e
            if implementation == :triton
                rethrow(e)
            end
        end
    end
    
    return gated_linear_unit_xla(
        x=x,
        weight=weight,
        activation=activation,
        precision=precision,
    )
end

using TempDirs

mutable struct Hmmbuild

    function Hmmbuild(;
        binary_path::String,
        singlemx::Bool = false,
        alphabet::Union{String, Nothing} = nothing,
    )
        check_binary_exists(path=binary_path, name="hmmbuild")
        new(binary_path, singlemx, alphabet)
    end

function build_profile_from_sto(self::Hmmbuild, sto::String, model_construction::String = "fast")::String
    return _build_profile(
        self,
        sto,
        informat="stockholm",
        model_construction=model_construction
    )
end

function build_profile_from_a3m(self::Hmmbuild, a3m::String)::String
    lines = String[]
    for (sequence, description) in lazy_parse_fasta_string(a3m)
        sequence = replace(sequence, r"[a-z]+" => "")
        push!(lines, ">$description\n$sequence\n")
    end
    msa = join(lines)
    return _build_profile(self, msa, informat="afa")
end

function _build_profile(
    self::Hmmbuild,
    msa::String,
    informat::String,
    model_construction::String = "fast",
)::String
    if !(model_construction in ["hand", "fast"])
        error("Bad model_construction=$model_construction. Only hand or fast allowed.")
    end
    
    mktempdir() do query_tmp_dir
        input_msa_path = joinpath(query_tmp_dir, "query.msa")
        output_hmm_path = joinpath(query_tmp_dir, "output.hmm")
        
        open(input_msa_path, "w") do f
            write(f, msa)
        end
        
        cmd_flags = ["--informat", informat]
        if model_construction == "hand"
            push!(cmd_flags, "--$model_construction")
        end
        if self.singlemx
            push!(cmd_flags, "--singlemx")
        end
        if self.alphabet !== nothing
            push!(cmd_flags, "--$(self.alphabet)")
        end
        append!(cmd_flags, [output_hmm_path, input_msa_path])
        
        cmd = [self.binary_path, cmd_flags...]
        run_subprocess(
            cmd=cmd,
            cmd_name="Hmmbuild",
            log_stdout=false,
            log_stderr=true,
            log_on_process_error=true,
        )
        
        hmm = open(output_hmm_path) do f
            read(f, String)
        end
        return hmm
    end
end

using LinearAlgebra

function _grid_keys(key, shape)
    if isempty(shape)
        return key
    end
    new_keys = map(i -> fold_in(key, i), 0:shape[1]-1)
    return map(k -> _grid_keys(k, shape[2:end]), new_keys)
end

function _padding_consistent_rng(f)
    function inner(key, shape; kwargs...)
        keys = _grid_keys(key, shape)
        signature = is_prng_key(eltype(keys)) ? "()->()" : "(2)->()"
        return vectorize((k) -> f(k, shape=(); kwargs...), signature)(keys)
    end
    return inner
end

function gumbel_argsort_sample_idx(key, logits)
    gumbel = _padding_consistent_rng(random_gumbel)
    z = gumbel(key, size(logits))
    axis = length(size(logits))
    iota = broadcasted_iota(Int64, size(logits), axis)
    _, perm = sort_key_val(logits .+ z, iota, dimension=-1, is_stable=false)
    return reverse(perm)
end

function create_msa_feat(msa)
    msa_1hot = onehot(msa.rows, POLYMER_TYPES_NUM_WITH_UNKNOWN_AND_GAP + 1)
    deletion_matrix = msa.deletion_matrix
    has_deletion = clamp.(deletion_matrix, 0.0, 1.0)
    has_deletion = reshape(has_deletion, size(has_deletion)..., 1)
    deletion_value = (atan.(deletion_matrix ./ 3.0) .* (2.0 / π))
    deletion_value = reshape(deletion_value, size(deletion_value)..., 1)
    msa_feat = [msa_1hot, has_deletion, deletion_value]
    return cat(msa_feat..., dims=ndims(msa_feat[1])+1)
end

function truncate_msa_batch(msa, num_msa::Int)
    indices = 0:num_msa-1
    return index_msa_rows(msa, indices)
end

function create_target_feat(batch, append_per_atom_features::Bool)
    token_features = batch.token_features
    target_features = []
    push!(target_features, onehot(token_features.aatype, POLYMER_TYPES_NUM_WITH_UNKNOWN_AND_GAP))
    push!(target_features, batch.msa.profile)
    push!(target_features, reshape(batch.msa.deletion_mean, size(batch.msa.deletion_mean)..., 1))
    
    if append_per_atom_features
        ref_mask = batch.ref_structure.mask
        element_feat = onehot(batch.ref_structure.element, 128)
        element_feat = mask_mean(mask=reshape(ref_mask, size(ref_mask)..., 1), value=element_feat, axis=-2, eps=1e-6)
        push!(target_features, element_feat)
        pos_feat = batch.ref_structure.positions
        pos_feat = reshape(pos_feat, size(pos_feat, 1), :)
        push!(target_features, pos_feat)
        push!(target_features, ref_mask)
    end
    return cat(target_features..., dims=ndims(target_features[1]))
end

function create_relative_encoding(seq_features, max_relative_idx::Int, max_relative_chain::Int)
    rel_feats = []
    token_index = seq_features.token_index
    residue_index = seq_features.residue_index
    asym_id = seq_features.asym_id
    entity_id = seq_features.entity_id
    sym_id = seq_features.sym_id
    
    left_asym_id = reshape(asym_id, :, 1)
    right_asym_id = reshape(asym_id, 1, :)
    left_residue_index = reshape(residue_index, :, 1)
    right_residue_index = reshape(residue_index, 1, :)
    left_token_index = reshape(token_index, :, 1)
    right_token_index = reshape(token_index, 1, :)
    left_entity_id = reshape(entity_id, :, 1)
    right_entity_id = reshape(entity_id, 1, :)
    left_sym_id = reshape(sym_id, :, 1)
    right_sym_id = reshape(sym_id, 1, :)
    
    offset = left_residue_index .- right_residue_index
    clipped_offset = clamp.(offset .+ max_relative_idx, 0, 2 * max_relative_idx)
    asym_id_same = left_asym_id .== right_asym_id
    final_offset = ifelse.(asym_id_same, clipped_offset, (2 * max_relative_idx + 1) .* ones(eltype(clipped_offset), size(clipped_offset)))
    rel_pos = onehot(final_offset, 2 * max_relative_idx + 2)
    push!(rel_feats, rel_pos)
    
    token_offset = left_token_index .- right_token_index
    clipped_token_offset = clamp.(token_offset .+ max_relative_idx, 0, 2 * max_relative_idx)
    residue_same = (left_asym_id .== right_asym_id) .& (left_residue_index .== right_residue_index)
    final_token_offset = ifelse.(residue_same, clipped_token_offset, (2 * max_relative_idx + 1) .* ones(eltype(clipped_token_offset), size(clipped_token_offset)))
    rel_token = onehot(final_token_offset, 2 * max_relative_idx + 2)
    push!(rel_feats, rel_token)
    
    entity_id_same = left_entity_id .== right_entity_id
    push!(rel_feats, reshape(convert(eltype(rel_pos), entity_id_same), size(entity_id_same)..., 1))
    
    rel_sym_id = left_sym_id .- right_sym_id
    max_rel_chain = max_relative_chain
    clipped_rel_chain = clamp.(rel_sym_id .+ max_rel_chain, 0, 2 * max_rel_chain)
    final_rel_chain = ifelse.(entity_id_same, clipped_rel_chain, (2 * max_rel_chain + 1) .* ones(eltype(clipped_rel_chain), size(clipped_rel_chain)))
    rel_chain = onehot(final_rel_chain, 2 * max_relative_chain + 2)
    push!(rel_feats, rel_chain)
    
    return cat(rel_feats..., dims=ndims(rel_feats[1]))
end

function shuffle_msa(key, msa)
    key, sample_key = split(key)
    logits = (clamp.(sum(msa.mask, dims=ndims(msa.mask)), 0.0, 1.0) .- 1.0) .* 1e6
    index_order = gumbel_argsort_sample_idx(sample_key, logits)
    return index_msa_rows(msa, index_order), key
end

function query(self::Jackhmmer, target_sequence::String)
    if length(target_sequence) <= 16
        @info "Query sequence: $target_sequence"
    else
        @info "Query sequence: $(target_sequence[1:16])... (len $(length(target_sequence)))"
    end
    
    mktempdir() do query_tmp_dir
        input_fasta_path = joinpath(query_tmp_dir, "query.fasta")
        create_query_fasta_file(sequence=target_sequence, path=input_fasta_path)
        output_sto_path = joinpath(query_tmp_dir, "output.sto")
        
        cmd_flags = [
            "-o", "/dev/null",
            "-A", output_sto_path,
            "--noali",
            "--F1", string(self.filter_f1),
            "--F2", string(self.filter_f2),
            "--F3", string(self.filter_f3),
            "--cpu", string(self.n_cpu),
            "-N", string(self.n_iter),
        ]
        
        if self.e_value !== nothing
            append!(cmd_flags, ["-E", string(self.e_value)])
            append!(cmd_flags, ["--incE", string(self.e_value)])
        end
        if self.z_value !== nothing
            append!(cmd_flags, ["-Z", string(self.z_value)])
        end
        if self.max_sequences !== nothing && self.supports_seq_limit
            append!(cmd_flags, ["--seq_limit", string(self.max_sequences)])
        end
        
        cmd = vcat([self.binary_path], cmd_flags, [input_fasta_path, self.database_path])
        run_subprocess(
            cmd=cmd,
            cmd_name="Jackhmmer ($(basename(self.database_path)))",
            log_stdout=false,
            log_stderr=true,
            log_on_process_error=true,
        )
        
        a3m = open(output_sto_path) do f
            convert_stockholm_to_a3m(f, max_sequences=self.max_sequences)
        end
        
        return MsaToolResult(
            target_sequence=target_sequence,
            a3m=a3m,
            e_value=self.e_value
        )
    end
end

using LinearAlgebra

const PRECISION = Union{Nothing, Symbol, Tuple{Symbol, Symbol}}
const DEFAULT_PRECISION = nothing
const TRUNCATED_NORMAL_STDDEV_FACTOR = 0.87962566103423978f0

mutable struct LayerNorm
    axis::Int

    offset_init::Union{Function, Nothing}

    _temp_create_offset::Bool
    
    function LayerNorm(;
        axis::Int = -1,
        create_scale::Bool = true,
        create_offset::Bool = true,
        eps::Float64 = 1e-5,
        scale_init::Union{Function, Nothing} = nothing,
        offset_init::Union{Function, Nothing} = nothing,
        use_fast_variance::Bool = true,
        name::String,
        param_axis::Union{Int, Nothing} = nothing,
        upcast::Bool = true,
    )
        new(axis, false, false, eps, nothing, nothing, use_fast_variance, name, param_axis, upcast, create_scale, create_offset)
    end
end

function (ln::LayerNorm)(x::Array)
    dtype = eltype(x)
    is_16bit = dtype in [Float16, BFloat16]
    if ln.upcast && is_16bit
        x = convert(Array{Float32}, x)
    end
    
    param_axis = ln.param_axis !== nothing ? ln.param_axis : -1
    param_shape = (size(x, param_axis),)
    param_broadcast_shape = ones(Int, ndims(x))
    param_broadcast_shape[param_axis] = size(x, param_axis)
    
    scale = nothing
    offset = nothing
    if ln._temp_create_scale
        scale = get_parameter("scale", param_shape, eltype(x), init=ln.scale_init)
        scale = reshape(scale, param_broadcast_shape...)
    end
    if ln._temp_create_offset
        offset = get_parameter("offset", param_shape, eltype(x), init=ln.offset_init)
        offset = reshape(offset, param_broadcast_shape...)
    end
    
    out = layer_norm_impl(x, scale=scale, offset=offset, axis=ln.axis, eps=ln.eps)
    if ln.upcast && is_16bit
        out = convert(Array{dtype}, out)
    end
    return out
end

function haiku_linear_get_params(
    inputs::Union{Array, NamedTuple};
    num_output::Union{Int, Vector{Int}},
    use_bias::Bool = false,
    num_input_dims::Int = 1,
    initializer::String = "linear",
    bias_init::Float64 = 0.0,
    transpose_weights::Bool = false,
    name::Union{String, Nothing} = nothing,
)
    if isa(num_output, Int)
        output_shape = (num_output,)
    else
        output_shape = tuple(num_output...)
    end
    
    if num_input_dims > 0
        in_shape = size(inputs)[end-num_input_dims+1:end]
    elseif num_input_dims == 0
        in_shape = ()
    else
        error("num_input_dims must be >= 0.")
    end
    
    weight_init = _get_initializer_scale(initializer, in_shape)
    
    if transpose_weights
        weight_shape = vcat(output_shape, in_shape)
        weights = get_parameter("weights", shape=weight_shape, dtype=eltype(inputs), init=weight_init)
    else
        weight_shape = vcat(in_shape, output_shape)
        weights = get_parameter(name="weights", shape=weight_shape, dtype=eltype(inputs), init=weight_init)
    end
    
    bias = nothing
    if use_bias
        bias = get_parameter(name="bias", shape=output_shape, dtype=eltype(inputs), init=constant_initializer(bias_init))
    end
    
    return weights, bias
end

mutable struct Linear
    output_shape::Tuple
    initializer::String
    use_bias::Bool
    bias_init::Float64
    num_input_dims::Int
    num_output_dims::Int
    precision::PRECISION
    fast_scalar_mode::Bool
    transpose_weights::Bool
    name::String
    
    function Linear(
        num_output::Union{Int, Vector{Int}};
        initializer::String = "linear",
        num_input_dims::Int = 1,
        use_bias::Bool = false,
        bias_init::Float64 = 0.0,
        precision::PRECISION = nothing,
        fast_scalar_mode::Bool = true,
        transpose_weights::Bool = false,
        name::String,
    )
        if isa(num_output, Int)
            output_shape = (num_output,)
        else
            output_shape = tuple(num_output...)
        end
        precision_val = precision !== nothing ? precision : DEFAULT_PRECISION
        new(output_shape, initializer, use_bias, bias_init, num_input_dims, length(output_shape), precision_val, fast_scalar_mode, transpose_weights, name)
    end
end

function (linear::Linear)(inputs::Array)
    num_input_dims = linear.num_input_dims
    
    if num_input_dims == 0 && linear.fast_scalar_mode
        weight_shape = linear.output_shape
        if linear.initializer == "zeros"
            w_init = constant_initializer(0.0)
        else
            distribution_stddev = 1.0 / TRUNCATED_NORMAL_STDDEV_FACTOR
            w_init = truncated_normal_initializer(mean=0.0, stddev=distribution_stddev)
        end
        weights = get_parameter("weights", weight_shape, eltype(inputs), w_init)
        inputs_expanded = reshape(inputs, size(inputs)..., ones(Int, linear.num_output_dims)...)
        output = inputs_expanded .* weights
    else
        if linear.num_input_dims > 0
            in_shape = size(inputs)[end-linear.num_input_dims+1:end]
        else
            in_shape = ()
        end
        weight_init = _get_initializer_scale(linear.initializer, in_shape)
        
        in_letters = "abcde"[1:linear.num_input_dims]
        out_letters = "hijkl"[1:linear.num_output_dims]
        
        if linear.transpose_weights
            weight_shape = vcat(linear.output_shape, in_shape)
            weights = get_parameter("weights", weight_shape, eltype(inputs), weight_init)
            equation = "...$in_letters, $out_letters$in_letters->...$out_letters"
        else
            weight_shape = vcat(in_shape, linear.output_shape)
            weights = get_parameter("weights", weight_shape, eltype(inputs), weight_init)
            equation = "...$in_letters, $in_letters$out_letters->...$out_letters"
        end
        
        output = einsum(equation, inputs, weights, precision=linear.precision)
    end
    
    if linear.use_bias
        bias = get_parameter("bias", linear.output_shape, eltype(inputs), constant_initializer(linear.bias_init))
        output = output .+ bias
    end
    
    return output
end

function _get_initializer_scale(initializer_name::String, input_shape)
    if initializer_name == "zeros"
        w_init = constant_initializer(0.0)
    else
        noise_scale = 1.0
        for channel_dim in input_shape
            noise_scale /= channel_dim
        end
        if initializer_name == "relu"
            noise_scale *= 2
        end
        stddev = sqrt(noise_scale)
        stddev = stddev / TRUNCATED_NORMAL_STDDEV_FACTOR
        w_init = truncated_normal_initializer(mean=0.0, stddev=stddev)
    end
    return w_init
end
